context: Editorial auth strength/countdown messages against actual ASCII-only registration validation: Latin A–Z/a–z and digit0–9 explicitly named, no broader script support promised. Complete level/time placeholders, personal commands, honest password feedback and two-factor on/off states (disabled means off, never disability).16 regional locales; Persian/Dari password vocabulary retained; no authentication algorithm or policy changed.
